authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / authoritative local planning authority providers
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 37,736 brownfield-land records from 298 providers and states all data is from authoritative sources; these records identify sites with development potential and can carry exact references, organisation binding and geography. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round59 remote checkpoint/readback still exposes no authoritative brownfield-land reference, organisation/local-authority identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate site to this fixed slot. Choosing one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
